profile.title: Profile
profile.failed: The profile could not be loaded.
profile.emailChanged: Your email address is updated. Sign in with it from now on.
profile.pictureHint: Shown beside your sessions and automations
profile.pictureFailed: The picture could not be changed.
profile.emailHint: Used to sign in and for run notifications
profile.usernameHint: Appears in session logs and commit trailers
profile.saveFailed: Your changes could not be saved.

changeEmail.title: Change email
changeEmail.description: We send a link to the new address. Your account moves there when you follow it; until then you sign in with {{email}}.
changeEmail.sent: If {{email}} can be used, a link is on its way there. Follow it to finish the change.
changeEmail.failed: The link could not be sent.

security.heading: Sign-in
security.passwordHint: Changing it signs out every other device

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.description: Every other device signed in to your account is signed out.
changePassword.failed: The password could not be changed.

devices.heading: Devices
devices.signOutOthers: Sign out of all other devices
devices.failed: The devices could not be loaded.
devices.revokeFailed: That device could not be signed out.

account.heading: Account
account.deleteHint: Stops every session and removes your automations and host registrations. This cannot be undone.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account?
deleteAccount.description: Every session stops, your hosts are unpaired and your workspace, projects and sign-ins are removed. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.failed: Your account could not be deleted.

hosts.title: Hosts
hosts.description: Servers your sessions run on. Nothing on a host is exposed to the internet.
hosts.emptyHint: Hosts you connect appear here with their live session count. Sessions cannot start until one is online.
hosts.failed: The hosts could not be loaded.

repositories.title: Watched repositories
repositories.description: Open pull requests from these repositories show up in the Watching tab of the PR queue, even when nobody asked for your review.

modelProviders.title: Model providers
modelProviders.description: The keys your bots run on. Each bot uses its provider’s key; the key is stored encrypted and never shown again. New bots start on the default provider.
modelProviders.unavailable: This server isn’t set up to store provider keys yet (BOTS_PROVIDER_KEY), so bots can’t answer.

providers.chatgpt: GPT models, on your ChatGPT subscription instead of an API key.

dialog.title: {{provider}} key
dialog.description: Paste the API key. It replaces the one stored, and bots on {{provider}} use it from their next message.
dialog.label: API key

chatgpt.title: Connect ChatGPT
chatgpt.description: Sign in to ChatGPT and bots on ChatGPT run on your subscription, not on API billing.
chatgpt.step: Open OpenAI’s sign-in page and enter this code:
chatgpt.waiting: Waiting for you to approve the sign-in…
chatgpt.expired: This code expired. Get a new one to try again.
chatgpt.connected: Signed in. Bots on ChatGPT now run on this subscription.

cloudAgents.title: Cloud agents
cloudAgents.description: Run a session in a vendor’s cloud, on your own key: pick it under Cloud where a new session runs. It bills your plan with the vendor.
cloudAgents.unavailable: This server can’t keep a cloud agent key. Ask whoever runs it to set CLOUD_AGENTS_KEY.
cloudAgents.loadFailed: Couldn’t load your cloud agent providers.

providers.cursor: Cursor’s Cloud Agents, on any model Cursor offers, Grok included.

dialog.title: Connect {{provider}}
dialog.description: Paste a user API key from {{provider}}’s dashboard. {{provider}} checks it first, and it is never shown again.
dialog.label: API key

mail.title: Mail
mail.description: Connect your own Gmail accounts so your bots can search and read your mail and its attachments. Only your bots use them, and only for you.
mail.unavailable: This server can’t connect Gmail. Ask whoever runs it to set the Google client and MAIL_TOKEN_KEY.
mail.emptyDescription: Connect one and ask any bot things like “what did the accountant send last week?” or “summarise today’s unread mail”. Google will warn that the app isn’t verified yet; that is expected.
mail.atLimit: You can connect up to {{count}} accounts.
mail.disconnectDescription: Its access is revoked at Google and no bot can reach it again until you connect it anew. Nothing in your mailbox changes.
mail.renameDescription: What you and your bots call {{email}}, like “Personal” or “Work”.
mail.refused: Google didn’t grant access to Gmail.
